lines.t: Yes, it is. That desk by the window is mine.
Great. Are these notebooks for me?
Yes, they are. There’s a pen next to them too.
Does this desk have a socket?
Yes, it does. There are two sockets under it.
What are those boxes behind your chair?
They’re office supplies. There’s a lot of paper in the big one.
Is there a meeting room on this floor?
Yes. It’s next to the entrance. I’ll show you.
